description: This file defines attributes used for implicit stream subscriptions within the Orleans framework. It includes the ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute and RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute classes, which are used to mark grains for stream subscription based on various namespace filters. The classes provide mechanisms to specify namespace filters via strings, predicate types, or predicate instances, and generate bindings for grain types.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to mark grains as implicit stream subscriptions with various namespace filtering options.

classes.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Specialized attribute for regular expression-based stream namespace filtering, inheriting from ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
methods.description: Constructs an attribute to subscribe to all namespaces or specific namespaces/filters based on parameters.

methods.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
methods.description: Constructs an attribute to subscribe using a regex pattern for namespace filtering.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates configuration dictionaries for grain type bindings based on the specified namespace predicate and grain type.
